remediationMatrix.name: Artifact & Container Build Service
remediationMatrix.configurationLocation: System PATH / Docker Desktop / Remote CI Runner
remediationMatrix.minimumRequiredPermission: Local process execution / docker CLI access
remediationMatrix.actionRequired: Install Docker CLI or authenticate a remote container build runner.
remediationMatrix.expectedEvidence: CLI output displaying valid Docker Client & Server engine versions.
remediationMatrix.impactOnNextTransition: Unblocks B1 -> Enables producing reproducible container images.

remediationMatrix.name: Staging OCI Artifact Registry
remediationMatrix.actionRequired: Configure personal access token with read:packages scope for staging repository.
remediationMatrix.safeVerificationProcedure: Run read-only token metadata probe against GitHub API.
remediationMatrix.expectedEvidence: HTTP 200 OK with repository package read authorization.
remediationMatrix.impactOnNextTransition: Unblocks B2 -> Enables pulling base images and staging images.

remediationMatrix.name: Authoritative Staging Telemetry
remediationMatrix.actionRequired: Provide reachable Prometheus query endpoint or Datadog APM API key for staging.
remediationMatrix.safeVerificationProcedure: Query staging service availability and P95 latency metrics with 3s timeout.
remediationMatrix.expectedEvidence: JSON metric payload with fresh timestamps (<180s old) and valid latency numbers.
remediationMatrix.impactOnNextTransition: Unblocks B3 -> Allows automated health verification during staging pilots.

remediationMatrix.name: Signed Staging SLO Configuration
remediationMatrix.minimumRequiredPermission: Read-only access to signed SLO config
remediationMatrix.actionRequired: Provide versioned SLO document scoped for STAGING signed with Ed25519 key.
remediationMatrix.expectedEvidence: Cryptographic signature verification success with environment: STAGING.
remediationMatrix.impactOnNextTransition: Unblocks B4 -> Establishes authoritative staging error/latency thresholds.

remediationMatrix.name: Telegram Human Approval Delivery (Staging)
remediationMatrix.actionRequired: Provide active Telegram bot token and authorized owner ID from BotFather.
remediationMatrix.safeVerificationProcedure: Run read-only getMe probe against Telegram Bot API.
remediationMatrix.expectedEvidence: HTTP 200 with bot identity JSON. Note: Bot authentication does not equal approval.
remediationMatrix.impactOnNextTransition: Unblocks B5 -> Enables out-of-band delivery of staging approval requests.

remediationMatrix.name: Staging Deployment Target Connectivity & Permissions
remediationMatrix.actionRequired: Provide scoped Kubernetes kubeconfig restricted strictly to staging namespace.
remediationMatrix.safeVerificationProcedure: Run `kubectl auth can-i create deployment -n staging` (read-only auth probe).
remediationMatrix.expectedEvidence: Authorization confirmation for staging namespace with zero cluster-admin permissions.
remediationMatrix.impactOnNextTransition: Unblocks B6 -> Enables deploying workloads to isolated staging cluster.
